standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of constructible subsets as finite unions of locally closed subsets
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3177-3185)
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes the subset as a finite union of pieces whose openness in the constructible topology is easier to see.

core_obligations: Decompose: a constructible subset of a Noetherian space is a finite union of locally closed subsets (proof lines 3176-3185)

Openness of the pieces: each locally closed subset is the intersection of an open and a closed subset, and closed subsets of a Noetherian space are constructible-open too, so the pieces are open in the constructible topology (proof lines 3186-3196)
proof_roadmap: Noetherian 空间中的可构造子集是有限个局部闭子集之并。
局部闭 = 开 ∩ 闭；在可构造拓扑中开集与闭集都开 ⇒ 各片开 ⇒ 并开。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a constructible subset of a Noetherian topological space is open in the constructible topology (author lemma at source lines 3163-3174, label lemma-constructible-neighbourhood-Noetherian). The proof (source lines 3176-3197) decomposes the subset into finitely many locally closed pieces and observes that each of them is open in the constructible topology (proof lines 3176-3196).
